subject: general
question: Nayi Manzil Scheme launched by the government of India is related to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Skill training for minority youths.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Nayi Manzil Scheme** was launched by the Government of India to provide **skill training for minority youths.**
 
• It aims to bridge the academic and skill development gaps of the minority youth who are school dropouts or educated in the community education institutions like Madrasas.
 
• The scheme ensures that the youth from minority communities have access to skill training that will make them employable.
 
• It also focuses on providing formal education up to Class XII and offers certification that is recognized by both government and private employers.
 
• The initiative is part of the government's efforts to promote inclusive growth and improve the socio-economic conditions of the minority communities in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Minority Affairs** in collaboration with other central and state government agencies.
 
• It is part of the broader mission to enhance the educational and employment opportunities for minorities in India.
 
• Beneficiaries of the scheme are provided with **training in various trades and sectors** that are in demand in the job market.
 
• The scheme also includes **soft skills training, career counseling, and job placement support** to ensure holistic development and better employability.
